Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Native 4K rendering (no checkerboard)
Metadata.Note: From 3840 pixels wide the game switches to its 4K mode, which renders the scene at half width with checkerboard reconstruction (the Pro path). This keeps the 1080p mode at any size: the scene renders at full resolution with 4-sample depth, sharper and heavier on the GPU (over 100 FPS at 5120x2160 on an RTX 4090). Untick it for checkerboard. It changes nothing below 3840 pixels wide. In PS4 Pro mode the game also gets 512 MB more of its own video memory for the full-resolution scene (DMEM to 1024 MB in PS4 Pro mode), so 2048 races with many different ships load (#184).
Metadata.Author: d4g

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Skip the autosave notice
Metadata.Note: The autosave notice at start goes away as soon as the profile has loaded instead of staying 5.5 seconds (#84). It still shows while the profile loads.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Startup Hang
Metadata.Note: Fixes a random hang at start (black screen after 'NEW THREAD'). Always on.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Effects above 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: The shield, the weapon-absorb effect, the Detonator bomb's explosion and smoke ring, the boost flare and the underwater sound fade in and out at any frame rate, the ship's idle hover (and the camera following it) moves smoothly, the outside cameras lean with acceleration as much as at 60 FPS, wall hits and landings shake the camera as long as at 60 FPS, and other players' ships online settle onto their network positions as at 60 FPS. All of them move with the timing of the 60 FPS game at any frame rate. Without it, above 60 FPS they stay where they started: the shield shows only after a hit and then stays on screen; the hover moves in 1/60 s jumps. Always on.
Metadata.Author: nero

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Engine trail above 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: After a boost pad, the engine flame and trail go back to normal at any frame rate. They fade with the timing of the 60 FPS game at any frame rate. Without it, above 60 FPS they stay in the boosted state, even when the ship stops (#123). Always on.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Zone crash above 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Fixes a crash in HD Zone events at high frame rates (the HUD was drawn from a list the game was refilling). Always on.
Metadata.Author: nero

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Zone points above 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Zone races give their points by time, as the 60 FPS game: 60 a second at any frame rate. Without it the points grew with the frame rate (240 a second at 240 FPS). Always on.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Bug Fix - Model slots
Metadata.Note: Fixes a crash while a race loads (2048 Unity Square, Empire Climb): the game's list of loaded models was full. Always on.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Cheat - Unlock all HD and Fury events
Metadata.Note: Every event of the HD and HD Fury campaigns is open: the game counts 99998 campaign points. Nothing is written to your save; off, the events need your own points again.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
Metadata.Name: Cheat - Top rank in 2048
Metadata.Note: Your 2048 rank is 50, the highest, so everything that needs a rank is open. Your real experience points stay in your save; off, your own rank comes back.
Metadata.Author: AbdelmoumenDeghbouche

Metadata.Title: WipEout Omega Collection
